questions.prompt: What does Adobe's Expand Image API do?

options.text: It expands an image out beyond its edges
options.explanation: Right. Adobe's tutorial uses it to make one photo fit many social media sizes.

options.text: It edits one area that a mask marks
options.explanation: That is the Fill Image API.

options.text: It puts a product photo into a scene
options.explanation: That is what the composite operations do.

questions.prompt: In an Adobe Firefly mask, which areas can the edit change?

options.explanation: Adobe says black areas are protected.
Right. Adobe says white areas are exposed to edits.
The mask splits the image: black is protected, white is open.

questions.prompt: What is the Firefly API's default rate limit per organization?

options.explanation: Right. Adobe says to contact your account manager for a higher limit.
Over the limit, Adobe returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
